title: Knitwear
description: We’re committed to lessening our impact on the environment and not overproducing. The complete knit garment construction method ensures we are avoiding waste during the manufacturing process. Each piece is artfully knit to the shape of the pattern at our partner facility in New York and crocheted together, completely avoiding fabric offcuts. Although this process takes more time, we only make what we need in small batches. These garments feature timeless designs made out of 100% natural wool fibers.

title: Lightweight Merino Jersey
description:
Merino wool is one of the most dynamic fibers on the planet. With natural performance properties such as UV and fire resistance, elasticity, moisture wicking, wrinkle resistance, and thermoregulation, you can’t go wrong.

Our ZQ-certified 100% merino wool ensures we are being responsible across the supply chain. This certification ensures the five animal freedoms are upheld, land management best practices are followed, and farmers can count on forward looking contracts to plan ahead. Use these pieces for a range of activities, as they were designed to be lightweight and move with your body — wherever life takes you.

title: The Donegal Collection
description:
Our warmest wool knit sweaters, cardigans, and fisherman toques made from the finest Donegal wools in chunky knit. Sustainably sourced and then milled in Ireland, with proper care these sweaters last a lifetime - that's why we offer Repairs or Life.

We love wool because it is naturally thermoregulating, odour-resistant, antimicrobial, sweat-wicking, and hugely durable. It's also easy to clean, preferring to be spot treated and stored folded (not on a hanger).

title: The Organic Cotton Collection
description:
Did you know only 1% of the total global cotton supply is certified organic? Our organic cotton products must meet a plethora of rigorous ecological and social criteria including no use of genetically modified seeds in production and no toxic chemicals and pesticides — all of which are harmful to biodiversity, local waterways, and field workers’ health.

Breathable and comfortable, organic cotton is known for being more durable and softer than conventional cotton. Feel good about the clothing that sits next to your skin with these consciously produced wardrobe essentials.

title: The Pre-Order Collection
description: We are passionate about small-batch production and responsible consumption. A pre-sale contributes to that cause, offering the opportunity for brands like Ecologyst to continue focusing on quality versus quantity. The fact that nearly 30% of all clothing produced globally is never purchased underscores a critical need for the fashion industry to rethink its approach. This statistic is a strong reminder of the environmental and financial costs tied to overproduction, highlighting an urgent opportunity to shift toward intentional practices that prioritize both people and planet.

title: Wool Wovens
description:
We offer a range of all-natural, woven wool products that are made in North America. Wool fibers make up approximately 1% of the total global fiber production, and provide excellent longevity.

This hypoallergenic material has been created in three weights to suit all seasons. Due to its natural odor and stain resistance you won’t have to wash as often, saving you time, energy, water and money.

The Light Washable Wool 9oz — With its soft flannel feel that can be worn like cotton, this New Zealand-based, ZQ-certified merino is perfect for all seasons and can be machine washed. 

The Medium Wool 11oz — Made into our ecologyst wool shirt, is perfect for layering to keep warm in the shoulder seasons.

 The Heavy Wool 23oz — This material is Climate Beneficial™ Wool certified by Fibershed and sourced from California. Used in our overshirt it is rugged, durable, and made for wet misty days as a top outer layer.
